description: Minister of Urban Development Construction and Housing - Urban Development Authority Law No.41 of 1978 of the National Stat Assembly.
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily deals with land matters, specifically the cancellation of a vesting order for a specific parcel of land described in detail in the schedule. It involves land acquisition and property rights (canceling the transfer of land to the Urban Development Authority), which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4). While it mentions a minister by name, this is incidental to the core land-related action being taken, and no detailed ministerial portfolio responsibilities are described beyond the minister's title.
